title: A plan's repro that starts coord.py serve writes its key files with mode 0600
goal: skills/sprint/SKILL.md plan step 6 says a repro or check that starts a server reading key or token files (coord.py serve) writes them with the mode the server demands (0600), and precheck's traceback line is read before the start gate. run:

t=open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read();i=t.find('## plan "<goal>"');s=t[i:t.find('\n## ',i+3)] if i>=0 else ''
